schema:
CREATE TABLE depots (depot_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, label TEXT);

CREATE TABLE inventory (depot_id INTEGER, units_ready INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY (depot_id) REFERENCES depots (depot_id));
correct_query: SELECT DISTINCT depot_id, label FROM (SELECT LHS.depot_id AS depot_id, LHS.label AS label, RHS.units_ready AS units_ready FROM depots AS LHS INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM inventory WHERE (units_ready > 10)) AS RHS ON (LHS.depot_id = RHS.depot_id)) ORDER BY depot_id, label NULLS LAST
